name: TheAtticAI - Promptfoo API Documentation
description:
# Welcome to Promptfoo API

This documentation helps you understand and use the Promptfoo API for both **Self-Hosted** and **Enterprise** versions.

## 🏗️ Two Access Options

### ✅ **Self-Hosted (TheAtticAI)**
- **Server:** `https://promptfoo.theattic.ai`
- **Authentication:** IP Whitelisting only
- **Available Features:**
  - Check system health
  - View test results
  - Upload results from CLI

### 🔴 **Enterprise Cloud**
- **Server:** `https://api.promptfoo.app`
- **Authentication:** API Key required
- **Available Features:**
  - Manage teams and users
  - Configure roles and permissions
  - Set up red team testing
  - Configure adaptive guardrails
  - Set up webhooks
  - View and manage results with team controls

## 🌐 For Non-Enterprise Users

If you don't have an Enterprise account, you have two options:

**Option 1: Use the Web UI**
- Visit [Promptfoo Hosted - TheAtticAI](https://promptfoo.theattic.ai/) to access the web interface
- View your test results and reports directly in the browser

**Option 2: Request CLI Access**
- Contact TheAttic Team to request CLI authentication credentials
- This allows you to use Promptfoo from your command line

## 📚 Complete API Reference

For the complete list of all available APIs and detailed documentation, please visit:
[Promptfoo API Doc](https://www.promptfoo.dev/docs/api-reference/)

This documentation provides a summary of the most commonly used endpoints. For advanced features, detailed examples, and the latest updates, please refer to the official documentation.


## 📖 Helpful Links
- [Enterprise API Guide](https://www.promptfoo.dev/docs/api-reference/)
- [Teams Setup](https://www.promptfoo.dev/docs/enterprise/teams/)
- [Self-Hosting Guide](https://www.promptfoo.dev/docs/usage/self-hosting/)
- [Red Teaming Guide](https://www.promptfoo.dev/docs/red-team/)
- [Guardrails Guide](https://www.promptfoo.dev/docs/red-team/guardrails/)
